title: Security onboarding playbook: SSO/SAML, RBAC matrix, auditing, and KMS/HSM signoff PRD
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Produce an actionable product requirements document and signoff checklist for onboarding enterprise customers to Redwood Private with SSO/SAML, RBAC, comprehensive audit logging, and customer keying options (KMS/HSM). This PRD centralizes requirements, acceptance criteria, integration patterns, and post-deployment verification steps so Solutions, Security, and Engineering can execute a predictable handoff for regulated customers.
scope_summary: In scope: SSO (SAML 2.0) integration template and metadata exchange, RBAC role matrix and API for role binding, immutable audit log schema (events, retention, export), KMS integration for envelope encryption, HSM key import/export patterns, signoff checklist and customer acceptance tests. Out of scope: implementing custom identity providers beyond SAML, full multi-tenant RBAC redesign, external SIEM ingestion adapters (will be separate EPIC).
scope_changes_process: All scope changes go through a formal change request: PM submits a change note and risk assessment, Security triages for compliance impact, Engineering provides cost/time delta, and stakeholders vote in the weekly PL meeting. Emergency scope adjustments require a written exception and signoff from Head of Product and Head of Security.
detailed_requirements: 1) SSO/SAML: SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, metadata upload UI, cert rotation window UI, test-idp mode, SAML attribute mappings for (email, name, groups, role_hint). 2) RBAC: roles (Admin, Ops, Viewer, DevAccess, Billing), resource scoping (org, project, deployment), API to bind/unbind roles, audit trail for role changes. 3) Audit logs: event taxonomy (auth, authz, api_call, config_change, key_operation), immutable append-only store, configurable retention (90/365 days), export to customer S3/Cloud Storage, GDPR-sensitive fields redaction controls. 4) KMS/HSM: support Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) via KMS CMK import, envelope encryption flow, key rotation semantics, HSM-backed signing for attestation, and key usage logs surfaced in audit events.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Customer can complete SP/IdP exchange and login via at least two IdPs (Okta, AzureAD) using provided metadata within two hours.
SSO/SAML: SAML attribute mappings can be configured in Console UI and verified via test assertions; automated test harness validates nameID and group claims.
RBAC: Admin can create a custom role and bind it to a user/group; subsequent API calls show access granted/denied consistent with role rules.
RBAC: Role changes are recorded in audit logs with actor, timestamp, previous_role, and new_role fields.
Audit logs: Events conform to the specified schema, are immutable for 30 days, and can be exported to a customer S3 bucket with no missing events in a 24-hour sample window.
KMS/HSM: Customer can import an externally generated key or link a cloud KMS CMK; encryption/decryption roundtrip for stored secrets succeeds and key-use events appear in audit logs.
Signoff: Security, Solutions, and an assigned customer contact each provide written acceptance on the signoff checklist after performing the acceptance tests.
Backward compatibility: Console UI changes do not break existing hosted customers; feature toggles exist for Private rollout.
signoff_checklist: Identity: Verify SAML metadata upload and test login with sample Okta tenant
Identity: Rotate SP certificate and confirm successful SSO without session loss
RBAC: Create roles; validate least-privilege principle with negative tests
RBAC: Confirm role bindings are reversible and logged
Audit: Seed simulated traffic and verify completeness/ordering of audit events
Audit: Confirm retention policy enforcement and S3 export correctness
Keys: Demonstrate BYOK import flow for AWS KMS and on-prem HSM key import with attestation
Keys: Validate key rotation and re-encryption process does not break existing data reads
Docs: Publish operator runbook and customer onboarding checklist
Legal/Sec: Receive written signoff from Security and Compliance teams
implementation_notes: Use existing SAML library used in hosted product, but add metadata validation and test connectors for Private UI
Leverage audit pipeline (Kafka -> immutable store) and add schema versioning before export connectors
Implement RBAC as an authorization layer that consults a roles engine with feature flags for gradual rollout
KMS/HSM work should reuse crypto primitives in infra library and add key-use counters to the audit event payload
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Prefer standard SAML 2.0 with limited custom extension support to reduce IdP compatibility issues
Tradeoff: Full SCIM provisioning is deferred (complex integration) — we will provide SCIM adapter as a follow-up EPIC
Decision: Default audit retention set to 90 days with opt-in for 365; longer retention will increase storage costs for private deployments
Tradeoff: BYOK will support KMS and HSM import but not live HSM replication across regions in launch phase
qa_plan: Create automated integration tests that spin up a test IdP and run SP/IdP flows
Simulate role escalation and negative authorization tests in staging
Run audit event fuzzing to detect schema regressions and ordering problems
Key lifecycle tests: import, rotate, revoke, and ensure decryption of existing objects
rollout_and_migration_plan: Canary rollout to 3 pilot customers with a Solutions PM present
Collect telemetry on SSO success rates, latency of role checks, and audit export throughput for two weeks
Migration: provide a one-click import wizard for existing hosted customer metadata and a dry-run mode for Private upgrades
Backout: disable SSO flag and fallback to local accounts; restore previous key mapping from snapshot if re-encryption fails
unresolved_questions: Do we require SCIM provisioning in scope for select enterprises? (impact: engineering effort + legal review)
What is the maximum acceptable time for key rotation during which reads must remain available?
Should we delay 365-day retention support until we have a cost-recovery pricing proposal for Private customers?
notes_for_solutions_engineering: Include pre-built test harness and checklist for customer kickoff calls. Supply a one-page diagram of the SSO flow and an example audit export for customer SIEM teams.
post_release_metrics: SSO success rate (target > 99% for pilot customers)
Mean time to onboard (target < 4 hours for standard IdPs)
Audit export completeness (0 missing events in 24h sample)
Incidents related to key management (target 0 in first 90 days)
